title: 24:8 mirth/noise/joy. Isa. 24:7-11 draws a strong correlation between the sounds of gaiety and the free abundance of wine. The party lifestyle of the world, which so often depends on alcohol, will cease to exist; instead of the sounds of laughter, groans of discontent will prevail. The dependency on artificial stimulants for happiness indicates the pitiful state of the earth's inhabitants.
author: Tina M. Peterson
